name: Court House Square
address: Clark, Randolph, LaSalle and Washington Streets

status.text: The fire swept through it in 1871
status.today: The City Hall and County Building stands on the square
status.note: The Court House in the middle burned out; the square stayed the seat of the city and county.

built.note: Laid out round the Court House finished in 1853.

summary: The open square round the Court House. The building stood in the middle, back from the streets, behind an iron fence on a stone base. Trees and lamps stood along the walks.

key.label: In the middle
key.value: The Court House and City Hall

notable.text: A photograph from 1871 shows the iron fence along Randolph Street. A gate stands before the north steps.
Where the fence ran and its other gateways are a guess.
notable.note: Only the Randolph Street side is pictured.

story.text: Around midnight the Court House cupola catches fire. Its bell falls at 2:05 a.m.
